# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 2 tokens; Borders and rings — 4 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 16 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 6 tokens; Radius — 6 tokens; Shadow — 3 tokens; Size — 6 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--surface);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value */
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `surface` | #ffffff | App, preview and panel background (.cp-app, .cp-preview, .panel); download button fill; slider thumb ring (4px border). |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--ink);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ink` | #09090b | All control text on `surface` and `input-bg`: input values, toggle/checkbox labels, snippet code, dimension label. 19.6:1 on surface, 18:1 on input-bg. |
| `ink-muted` | #00000098 | Field labels (.field-label), input icons/prefix letters, opacity % suffix. Resolves to about #808080 on surface: 3.9:1, and 3.6:1 on input-bg, below 4.5:1 for 9–11px text. Kept exact from source; flagged. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--White);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value */
```

### Tokens (16)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `White` | #ffffff | Background |
| `Black` | #000000 | Text |
| `input-bg` | #f5f5f5 | Fill of every 24px control (.input-wrap, slider value box), slider track, snippet textarea, cubic-bézier editor ground, toggle knob. |
| `focus-border` | #9d9d9d | 1px border on .input-wrap:focus-within and 1px focus-visible outline on toggle/checkbox rows. 2.7:1 on surface, below the 3:1 focus-ring floor; kept exact, flagged. |
| `hover-fill` | #fafafa | Download button hover background. |
| `hover-overlay` | rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04) | Chevron hover wash inside a dimension control. |
| `control-fill` | #23272e | Active/selected state: slider fill and thumb, toggle track when on, checked/indeterminate checkbox box. |
| `control-fill-off` | rgba(35, 39, 46, 0.6) | Toggle track when off. |
| `checkbox-border` | rgba(35, 39, 46, 0.3) | 2px border of an unchecked checkbox box. |
| `tick-mark` | rgba(134, 134, 134, 0.4) | 3×3px tick marks on a Slider Tick track. |
| `menu-bg` | #000000 | Dropdown menus (dimension menu, option selector) — the kit's menus are black. |
| `menu-text` | #ffffff | Menu option text on `menu-bg` (21:1). |
| `menu-item-active` | rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.18) | Hovered/active menu option on `menu-bg`. |
| `bezier-handle` | #4372ff | Cubic-bézier handle lines and handle strokes — the kit's only chromatic colour. |
| `bezier-handle-focus` | #2952cc | Cubic-bézier handle stroke when focused. |
| `bezier-curve` | #000000 | Cubic-bézier curve stroke (3px) and guide lines (40% opacity). |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-control);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `control` | `.control`, `--text-control` | 11px / 16px | 500 | `sans` | Every control value and row label: inputs, toggles, checkboxes, menus, buttons. Colour `ink`. |
| `field-label` | `.field-label`, `--text-field-label` | 9px / 14px | 500 | `sans` | Field labels above a control row (.field-label, slider labels). Colour `ink-muted`, capitalized. |
| `preview-box` | `.preview-box`, `--text-preview-box` | 14px / 1 | 500 | `sans` | Default text in the preview area (.cp-preview-box). |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 9px / 16px | 500 | `mono` | Snippet Output textarea only. DM Mono is used nowhere else. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `Inter, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"DM Mono", monospace` |

## Spacing

Exact values from base.css and component CSS; no grid snapping.

### Use

```css
padding: var(--field-padding-x);
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `field-padding-x` | 16px | Horizontal padding of every .field, slider field and divider (0 16px). |
| `field-gap` | 16px | Bottom margin between fields; panel vertical padding. |
| `row-gap` | 8px | Gap inside .row, between stacked rows, label → control, and between slider value and track. |
| `input-inset` | 7px | Text inset inside an .input-wrap with no icon; chevron and suffix padding. |
| `menu-offset` | 4px | Gap between a dimension control and its menu; divider vertical padding. |
| `menu-padding` | 2px | Inner padding of dropdown menus; toggle track padding. |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-control) */
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-control` | 5px | Inputs, slider track and fill, snippet textarea, buttons, menu options, colour preview. |
| `radius-menu` | 8px | Dropdown menus; toggle track and knob. |
| `radius-app` | 12px | Outer corner of .cp-app (0 in fullscreen). |
| `radius-checkbox` | 4px | Checkbox box. |
| `radius-swatch` | 2px | 14px colour swatch in Color Input. |
| `radius-round` | 50% | Slider thumb. |

### Use


## Size

Fixed dimensions the kit's layout depends on.

### Use

```css
/* var(--panel-width) */
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `panel-width` | 241px | Control panel sidebar width (240px field + 1px border). Changing it means updating all field CSS. |
| `field-width` | 240px | Width of every field, slider field and divider. |
| `control-height` | 24px | Height of every input, toggle/checkbox row, menu option and button. |
| `slider-track-width` | 144px | Slider track width beside the value box. |
| `slider-track-height` | 16px | Slider track height; toggle track height. |
| `slider-thumb-size` | 20px | Slider thumb diameter including its 4px white ring. |
